explanation_full: The KNN model demonstrated the best performance across multiple metrics compared to all other benchmark models (RF, XGBoost, SVM, and DT). Specifically, KNN achieved an R2 score of 0.8172, an RMSE of 0.1132, and an MAE of 0.075. These values are superior to the corresponding metrics of the other models. For instance, KNN's R2 score (0.8172) is higher than RF (0.7756), XGBoost (0.7495), SVM (0.7324), and DT (0.5605). Similarly, KNN's RMSE (0.1132) is lower than all other models, and its MAE (0.075) is the lowest among the group. The residual analysis also shows a strong correlation between predicted and actual values (0.9073).
